benchmark_1_positive_control.details: Correctly reconstructed standard cleavable Topo I / tubulin ADC architecture for low-risk HER2 tumor.

benchmark_2_counterfactual_avoidance.details: 100% of iterations successfully rejected cell-permeable cleavable bystander linkers and switched to non-cleavable SMCC / safe payloads under severe ILD.

benchmark_3_ddi_bypass.details: Successfully identified CYP3A4 blockade and steered away from MMAE/MMAF to non-CYP cleared payloads.

benchmark_4_chemical_sanity.details: All candidate payloads meet medicinal chemistry drug-likeness (QED >= 0.50) and synthesis accessibility standards (SAScore <= 4.0).

benchmark_5_gtex_safety_margin.details: Tumor-to-normal tissue expression ratio exceeds log2FC 2.0 threshold across all clinical indications (mean log2FC = 4.44).
